format: JavaScript Module (ESM) with TypeScript and Node.js
description: This source file provides utility functions for handling module specifiers, inventory comparison, file path normalization, and inventory collection within a TypeScript/Node.js project. It is part of a utility library related to managing module dependencies and inventory checks.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a repository-relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to the repository root, handling relative and absolute paths.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file AST to find and visit import, export, and dynamic import specifiers.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory entries, returning missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a stream, appending a newline.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple TypeScript source files, parses them, and collects inventory entries from each.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline check by comparing actual inventory with expected, outputting results in JSON or human-readable format.
